description:
The relationship between On Tae-hyuk and Chae Ji-a was all lies.

"I quit."

The jet-black hair and eyes, the relationship that was supposed to be nothing more than an executive and a secretary. So Jia tried to end all the lies by leaving Tae-hyuk.

"Secretary Chae.... I didn't hear anything, I didn't see anything."  
"I have nothing more to say."

The distance between them grew a little closer. Tae-hyuk's hand touched her dark hair.

"I don't think I want to keep quiet anymore either."  
"Ms. On, wait, wait, wait. Ouch!"

White hair, resembling snow falling in the middle of winter, mingled with jet-black hair, resembling the deepest night, and spilled out. Over her dark colored jacket. Like a soundless snowfall.

"Hide and seek is over.  
It's good to see you again. Bye."

But just as she was about to end it all,  
his relentless, dark obsession reared its ugly head.
